verdict.rationale: Fern is a SaaS documentation and SDK platform with an API, CLI, and MCP servers, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials to an agent is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents scoped API tokens or per-agent permissions. Visitor authentication (JWT, SSO) and password-protected docs control who can read a docs site, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
